Subject: Discovery recap: data privacy & logging constraints

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we're all aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- PII in model inputs/outputs and how it appears in operational logs (needs redaction at write time).
- Retention policy: strict 90-day retention for any inference artifacts containing customer data.
- Auditability: ability to produce per-request audit logs (who, when, model version, input hash) for compliance reviews.
- Right-to-delete / data subject requests: need guarantee that inference artifacts can be deleted on demand.

Current stack & constraints:
- Platform: internal inference layer + Snowflake for analytics; KMS for key management (AWS KMS).
- Production traffic: ~200k requests/day peak, mixed short/long context usage.
- Security: SOC2 in progress; procurement will handle the security questionnaire.

Success criteria for an initial PoC:
1) No PII persisted in readable logs (automated redaction or never logged in plaintext).
2) 90-day retention configurable, automatic purge capability.
3) Per-request audit logs exportable (CSV/JSON) with access controls.
4) Ability to honor deletion requests and show evidence.

Proposed next steps:
- Share our security questionnaire (I attached a stub) and receive their procurement contact details.
- Technical deep-dive with your infra team (30–45m) — I'll propose times.
- Draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) and proposed PoC timeline (4–6 weeks).

Attachments: redwood-privacy-md.pdf (privacy & logging overview), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (PoC milestones)

I'll follow up with 2–3 time slots for the deep-dive. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — great summary.

A few clarifications:
- Redaction: we need field-level redaction at inference time (not only in post-process logs). Some downstream systems store raw payloads; we need guarantees that those do not receive unredacted PII.
- Deletion: we require verifiable deletion for any stored artifacts within 72 hours of a request.
- Encryption: integration with our KMS (AWS KMS) and support for customer-managed keys is required.

Procurement is included on this thread (procurement@fintechcorp.com), they'll send over the completed security questionnaire. I've also uploaded our standard security questionnaire here: https://drive.google.com/fintech-security-questionnaire

We're interested in a PoC that demonstrates redaction + auditability with a subset of traffic.

Best,
Alice
